# Broadcaster — Mobile Delta Plan

The Awtsmoos lets every gesture answer the hand that called;
Awtsmoos.com should make hover, press, focus, and touch feel equally walled.

## Evidence

- Broadcaster tree is currently clean in git, so an isolated rewrite does not collide with concurrent work.
- Existing stage CSS already constrains media width to stage width.
- `StageDragController.clamp()` computes responsive stage/media rectangles and bounds translated X/Y so dragged surfaces cannot escape the stage.
- Existing contract suite passes 7/7.
- `.action` defines transform/background/border transitions and a `:hover` motion state but no `:active` pressed state.
- Advanced disclosure summary is interactive and focus-visible, but has no hover/active visual feedback.
- User explicitly requires animated controls to have coherent hover and active states.

## Exact rewrite

Rewrite only `apps/broadcaster/styles/controls.css` completely.

Preserve layout, dimensions, palette, advanced panel default folding, reduced-motion behavior, and mobile two-column action layout. Add:
- hover effects only under `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`;
- `.action:active` compressed/settled pressed feedback;
- disabled button visual state that does not animate misleadingly;
- summary transition with fine-pointer hover and universal active press feedback;
- `accent-color` for the advanced checkbox so the native control no longer feels detached from the visual system;
- reduced-motion neutralization for action and disclosure transitions.

## Verification

Run existing Broadcaster contract tests. Then serve local source and measure desktop, 390×844, and 320×568 after full stylesheet load. Confirm no document horizontal overflow, all visible action buttons remain within viewport, advanced details stays folded by default and contained when opened, and computed active/transition rules are present.
